turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick question on my dev environment. I'm setting up the OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT env var for the new service.
Sure. What's the current configuration you're using?
I've got it set to truncate at 20 KB. Keeps the logs lean enough for our local disk space.
Understood. 20 KB is quite small for tool bodies, but it works if you're just debugging structure.
Yeah. Also, did you get a chance to look at that npm package I mentioned? The one with the security warning?
I reviewed the advisory. You should upgrade to the patched version immediately.
Good call. I'll do that tonight. Thanks.
Lloyd, I need to update the observability config for the staging cluster.
We're hitting issues with large API responses getting cut off. I've decided to change OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT to truncate at 60 KB instead.
Noted. 60 KB is a safer bet for full payload visibility.
Exactly. Also, did you hear it's supposed to rain all weekend?
The forecast looks pretty wet. Maybe plan some indoor activities.
Yeah, I'm thinking of finally finishing that puzzle box. Anyway, back to the config, I need to apply this change via CLI.
